name: Assistance Program for Planting in Floriculture
benefit:
> **Loose Flowers:** - ₹16,000 per hectare or 40% of cost for small/ marginal farmers. - ₹10,000 per hectare or 25% of cost for other farmers.
> **Stem (Cut) Flowers:** - ₹40,000 per hectare or 40% of cost for small/ marginal farmers. - ₹25,000 per hectare or 25% of cost for other farmers.
> **Tuberous Flowers:** - ₹60,000/- per hectare or 40% of cost for small/ marginal farmers.
_eligibility_text:
1. The applicant must be a farmer.
   1. The applicant must be engaged in floriculture farming (loose, cut, or tuberous flowers).
